ns2:course.label: Special Topics in EPOL
ns2:course.description: Introduction to significant problems, points of view, and trends in the field; explores significant research relating to organization, content, and techniques. Topics vary; consult Class Schedule for specific section offerings. Same as HRD 592. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated if topics vary. Prerequisite: Instructor approval required.
